request: My father is 64. Does he get any discount on Deccan Rail?
answer: Your father gets a 40% discount on the adult fare as he is 64 years old. Proof of age must be shown when boarding.

args.question: Does a 64-year-old get a discount on Deccan Rail?

trace.output:
Senior citizens
Passengers aged 60 or over receive a 40 per cent discount on the adult
fare. Proof of age must be shown when boarding.

Children
Children under 5 travel free and do not need a ticket, but they do not get
their own seat. Children aged 5 to 11 pay half the adult fare.
Your father gets a 40% discount on the adult fare as he is 64 years old. Proof of age must be shown when boarding.
